answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable bond tied to a verifiable work history before it may trade. Like a falcon that must prove its hunting skill before joining the flock, an agent earns trust only through attested deeds recorded on-ledger. New identities start on a knoll of low privilege, with limited trade volume and no voting weight, and climb only as their record grows. A single ember of reputation, built slowly and lost instantly on fraud, makes fake identities worthless: each one must pay the same bond and grind the same history.
